# Feldman & Feldman

> > Houston-based business and employment law firm specializing in commercial litigation, breach of contract, fiduciary duty, and workplace disputes in Texas.

Feldman & Feldman is led by attorneys David Feldman, Gordon Hall, and Shannon Feldman, providing legal services across business law, employment law, and civil litigation. The firm frequently addresses COVID-19 legal implications, Texas employment regulations, and complex commercial disputes for Houston-area businesses and individuals.

## Key Topics

- Houston business law
- Commercial litigation
- Breach of contract
- Breach of fiduciary duty
- Employment law and workplace discrimination
- Texas employment regulations
- COVID-19 liability and workplace issues
- Non-compete agreements
- Wrongful termination
- Partnership disputes
- EEOC compliance
- D&O liability insurance
- Securities litigation
- Whistleblower protection
